- docs site (index.md, _config.yml nav) and .github/FUNDING.yml   [BugHunter]
- remove the now-unreferenced atlas-cloud-*.svg assets

ThreatWatch360 co-sponsor unchanged. Historical CHANGELOG entry left intact.
